probe_note: https://www.instacart.com/ loaded signed out in an incognito T3 preview tab. The default preview profile was already signed in and was closed without a screenshot. Log in opens a dialog and /login is the same card: email field, Continue, Google, Facebook, Phone. Signup is the same shape at /signup. Nothing was typed. Continue was not clicked. No identity provider was clicked. The T3 preview pane did not produce screenshot frames, so photographs came from the package's headless public capture.

nav.note: No signed-in navigation was offered. The public storefront sidebar shows Account as a link, and the search page paints it while signed out. It was not opened.

settings.note: No settings control was offered on the public pages. Help lists Profile and Account Settings as an article row. It was not opened.

reached: signup card at /signup, photographed at rest
create.note: The signup card offers an empty email field, Continue, Google, Facebook, and Phone, plus a link to create a business profile. None of those were used.

gaps: Signed-in storefront, orders, account settings, and checkout were not entered.

Create free business account, Try free for 14 days, Send gift card, and Log in and Redeem were not clicked.
The phone homepage app sheet (Get the Instacart app) covers the lower half of the 390 viewport. Continue in browser was not found as a clickable control in the headless pass.
The T3 preview pane did not produce screenshot frames, so this pass has no in-pane photographs.
